description_en: Queries the user credential reports of an Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询阿里云账号（主账号）下的用户凭证报告
name: GetCredentialReport

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to initiate the next request if the response of the current request is truncated. You can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records.\`\`
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`NextToken`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be true.

Valid values: 1 to 3501. Default value: 3501
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于true。

取值范围：1~3501。默认值：3501
parameters.name: max_items

Content.description_en:
The content of the user credential report.

The report is Base64-encoded. After you decode the report, the credential report is in the CSV format
Content.description_zh:
用户凭证报告内容。

采用Base64编码，解码后是CSV格式的用户凭证报告内容

GeneratedTime.description_en: The time when the user credential report was generated
GeneratedTime.description_zh:
用户凭证报告的生成时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-19T15:06:52Z

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the response is truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true
false

NextToken.description_en: The parameter that is used to obtain the truncated part. This parameter takes effect only when `IsTruncated` is set to true
NextToken.description_zh: 此参数在`IsTruncated`为true时生效，用于获取截断后的内容
